bio:
Peter, 12 in 1910; in 1920 a laborer for a coal company (name hard to read, 'Quinn'? Coal Co.). Married Ann Horoski; d. 7 Oct 1974. Birth 26 Jul 1897 conflicts with Grace's 5 Jan 1897.

Peter is 12 in April 1910 and 22 in January 1920, which supports birth in 1897–98 ([R4-S1], [R4-S2]). That is consistent with the FS date of 26 Jul 1897 only if Grace/Katie was born in January 1897 and Peter was a twin or the dates are slightly off; the 1910 ages (13 and 12) suggest they were about a year apart, so one of the two dates is probably wrong. The FamilySearch tree links him through a Social Security NUMIDENT entry to a son, Victor M. Petrillo (1926–1989), whose mother is given as 'Anna Harosko' ([R4-S3]).
sources: [R4-S1] 1910 US census, Scranton Ward 10, ED 88, sheet 22A (enumerated 29 Apr 1910), 1030 Ash Street: John 'Petrillo' (35, immigrated 1880, naturalized, grocery store, own account), Marie (40, 6 children born, 6 living), Katie (daughter, F, 13), Peter (12), Frank (10), Joseph (5), Tony (3), Charlie (1).
